business_summary: Innovative Medical Management Co.,Ltd. engages in the medical services business in China. The company owns and operates Jianhua Hospital, Kanghua Hospital, Futian Hospital, and Mingzhu Hospital. It also offers outpatient, inpatient, rehabilitation services, and medical examination services. In addition, it offers supply chain management and procurement of pharmaceuticals, medical consumables, and equipment. The company was formerly known as Qianzu Pearl Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Innovative Medical Management Co.,Ltd. in June 2016. Innovative Medical Management Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Zhuji, China.
